output_units: nonnegative finite expected count per20ms bin, notHz
feature_description: 40 held-in neurons, packed/jittered go-time from −1500 to0ms;75 consecutive20ms bins. Predict simultaneous corresponding14 held-out neurons. Whole-trial context allowed; no smoothing across trials. Return shape(N,75,14). The official held-out target has a contiguous valid interval per trial and NaNs outside it. This hidden window reflects set→go timing and original random alignment jitter. All75 input bins are finite and retained unchanged. Predictions must be finite for all75 bins, while only finite target entries are scored. The hidden mask and jitter are scoring-only, never model inputs.
grouping: Official train+validation combined: 1006 trials; official test:283 trials. Same subject Haydn and source recording/session, distinct official trial partitions. No cross-session or cross-animal generalization claim. Test timeline is packed for release. Exact original session date is 2016-12-11; source NWB identity is preserved in recording-identity.json rather than inferred from packed timestamps.
scientific_task: Ready-set-go time interval reproduction; dorsomedial frontal cortex
terms: CC BY4.0 DANDI release metadata; MIT nlb_tools
baseline_name: Frozen baseE01 Gaussian sigma1bin population readout + Ridge alpha100; clip1e-6
evaluation_regime: Portability of original frozen E01 generated programs, unchanged source and hyperparameters, refitted on each new training array; no fresh model generation or post-test repairs
why_not_official_leaderboard: Supervised held-in→held-out readout diagnostic, not full unsupervised neural-latent model suite. No decoding, PSTH, timing correlation or forecasting metrics. Data are official, scorer official, learning regime customized.
macro_counting: Additional source slice under existing E01 ID; do not count as a new independent benchmark/task ID. Report datasets separately and aggregate atE01 level before cross-task comparisons.
metric_details: Exact pinned official NLB bits_per_spike; Poisson NLL improvement over per-neuron evaluation-set mean divided by total finite-target spikes andln2. Evaluation-set mean is scoring normalization only and never supplied to model. NaN targets ignored by np.nansum; zero expected counts replaced by1e-9; negative or nonfinite predictions rejected.
target_mask: exact official archived target NaN mask retained
